reason: I'd start the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge, but I already fall asleep to free YouTube rain sounds, and with my schedule changing every week I doubt the timing will get tuned well. At the end I'd probably just stay on the free version and not add another 4,900 won subscription.
objection: The 'it learns when to turn off' part sounds like marketing. Two weeks of rough sleep notes from my own phone won't prove the app made me fall asleep faster and not just a less stressful week.
would_change_my_mind: If my own 14-day record clearly showed I fell asleep 10+ minutes faster even on my late nights, I'd pay, and probably go for the yearly plan.
